title: RuView — Node Health
description: ESP32 sensing-node RSSI, signal quality, and message rate. Use this dashboard while tuning node positions.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensing")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "node" and r._field == "rssi_dbm")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "node_id"])

from(bucket: "sensing")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "node" and r._field == "rssi_dbm")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "node_id"])

panels.title: RSSI stability (30s stddev, dB)
panels.description: σ ≤ 1.5 dB is excellent; ≥ 5 dB indicates interference or unstable power.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensing")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "node" and r._field == "rssi_dbm")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 30s, fn: stddev, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "node_id"])

panels.title: Signal quality (global)
panels.description: Aggregated signal_quality from sensing-server. < 0.4 → vital-signs detector is unreliable.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensing")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "state" and r._field == "signal_quality")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.title: MQTT messages per node (per 30s)
panels.description: Proxy for bridge-side frame throughput. Note this is sensing-server tick rate (~10 Hz), not ESP32 raw UDP rate.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensing")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "node" and r._field == "rssi_dbm")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 30s, fn: count, createEmpty: true)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "node_id"])
